title: Anchor simulator TDMA windows to received beacon time
description: python/src/lichen/sim/tdma.py sync_from_beacon stores rx_time_us but is_tx_allowed ignores it and computes slot_start as SFN*N*duration from process time zero. Any simulation whose local time origin is not the global SFN epoch rejects its actual assigned window and may allow an unrelated future/past window. The test reproduces the same erroneous absolute formula, so it is self-confirming. Anchor the synchronized superframe to rx_time_us/base_time_us, define beacon timestamp semantics, validate current_time input and guard configuration, and add offset-clock/boundary tests.
